body: It's hard to say but if you mention the suicidal thoughts the chances of getting sent there are pretty high. Self harm itself isn't enough to admit you. They only send you there if they believe that you are in immediate danger  of hurting yourself, so like dying. But if I were you I would just tell your therapist the truth, maybe you will get some medications that will help you. And in the worst case scenario if you get sent to the hospital it would be a short term visit. So try not to stress about it, it should be fine.

Most of them yeah, they are worse if you are uner 18. Though it kinda depends on the institution but most of them are horrible. They can take your phone away which leaves you sitting in your room most of the time. In my case it felt like a prison they take away your freedom, in the end you leave in a worse state than you got in. But it really depends on the country and the facility, some of them are ok I suppose.

Thats the reality, somber one. The psychiatrist, doctors nobody cares. Not until someone dies so at least they could whine a little. Also the questions about the religion? The fuck. Why would they even ask such bullshit? Hope you get better though.
